messages:
maria: morning handoff - i'm primary until 17:00 UTC, kai is secondary. quick summary of overnight and current status.

maria: incidents -> 1) embeddings-autoscaler thrash 02:10-03:05 UTC, caused transient 429s for small number of customers (mainly prod sandbox). 2) regional-egress-503s in eu-west at ~04:30 UTC causing degraded responses for routes pinned to eu-west. 3) test-alert noise: batcher mem high alert flapped twice.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert (P2): embeddings-autoscaler-thrash triggered at 17002 (02:10 UTC). Auto-escalation to oncall at 02:12 UTC.

maria: what we did overnight -> for autoscaler thrash: reduced scaling aggressiveness (min_scale -> 2, cool_down -> 120s) and applied selector to avoid scaling on tiny synthetic traffic. rolled back those quick changes to a conf toggle 'autoscale.temp-stabilize' which is ON now.

kai: confirmed autoscaler toggle stabilized traffic. p95 tokens back to normal around 03:05. leaving toggle ON for 12h for monitoring.

noah: eu-west egress issue - root cause was a transit provider flap; we routed fallback to eu-central via routing policy 'regional-failover' at 04:35. customer impact: increased latency ~350ms for affected requests, a small spike in error rate to 1.8%.

rachel: i rebased the canary to route 25% to us-east as a protective measure for sensitive customers. added a temporary alert to catch >1% 5xx for pinned routes.

maria: current status -> autoscaler stabilized, eu-west still has occasional 503s but failover keeps overall success rate acceptable. SLO impact low but some customers saw degraded latency.

maria: open actions for today -> 1) follow up with infra network team to get carrier incident ticket (owner: kai). 2) revert autoscale.temp-stabilize after 12h if stable (owner: maria). 3) run a controlled scaling test when traffic quiet to exercise new backoff (owner: noah). 4) update runbook section "autoscaler-thrash" with throttling heuristics (owner: rachel).

kai: i'll file carrier ticket and link it here. ETA 2h.

ops-bot: Added incident ticket RW-INC-1284 to the incident tracker (https://redwood.internal/incidents/RW-INC-1284).

maria: quick runbook pointers -> autoscaler: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-thrash. routing failover: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/regional-failover. if you need to force-region-fallback run this (via infra-admin):

```bash
# force failover to eu-central for eu-west pinned routes
redwoodctl routing set-policy --from eu-west --to eu-central --filter pinned:true
```

noah: noted. i'll schedule the scaling test for 10:30 UTC once traffic dips. will post results here.

rachel: small note on alerts -> bumped the 5xx alert sensitivity temporarily; i'll rollback after 24h if no regressions.

maria: handoff notes for next shift (kai -> you): primary remains kai after i sign off at 17:00 UTC if nothing else pops. coverage gap: evening APAC overlap between 22:00-01:00 UTC has no dedicated secondary currently. suggestion: ask infra-team oncall to be secondary for that window or swap with storage oncall.

kai: i can cover until 20:00 UTC. if nothing major, i'll hand to noah at 20:00. noah?

noah: can do 20:00-02:00 UTC but i can't cover 22:00-01:00 reliably tomorrow due to travel. pinging @rachel to see if she can pick the APAC overlap.

rachel: i can take 22:00-01:00 UTC tomorrow. will add it to calendar and the oncall rotation sheet.

maria: thanks team. closing checklist before sign-off:
- confirm RW-INC-1284 has carrier updates (kai)
- autoscale.toggle expiry set (maria)
- scaling test scheduled (noah)
- runbook updates draft (rachel)

maria: if anyone sees a reoccurrence, escalate to P1 immediately and tag #sre-pager. i'll be reachable on mobile for 30m. :white_check_mark:

kai: carrier ticket created and linked to RW-INC-1284 - carrier says investigating, incident ref CARR-779.

noah: scaling test scheduled 10:30 UTC, will post output and graphs. test plan: ramp to 2x baseline, hold 5m, observe evictions and scale behavior.

rachel: started a draft for runbook updates, focusing on backoff/tolerance heuristics. will share PR by EOD.

incident-bot: RW-INC-1284 status updated -> monitoring.

maria: last note - customer comms: CS flagged 3 affected customers, CS drafted proactive note. ops-bot attached ticket CS-4521 to the incident.

ops-bot: Attached CS ticket CS-4521 to RW-INC-1284.

maria: ok i'm signing off now, leaving primary to kai. thanks all, see you on the bridge if needed.

kai: taking primary. good handoff.

noah: standing by for scaling test results.

rachel: will post runbook PR link when ready.

maria: (mobile) confirmed sign-off.
